name: IB Maths AI Prep: Modelwick
subtitle: Adaptive IB AI maths practice
shortDescription: Adaptive IB Maths AI practice for SL and HL: lessons, quizzes, labs, real-world builds and timed mock papers. Works offline, no account.
longDescription:
Modelwick is a study companion for IB Diploma Mathematics: applications and interpretation, at standard level and higher level. It teaches, tests and then decides what you should do next, using your own answers.

### Learn It Properly
Every point of the course content listing has short lessons in plain language, worked examples with method, accuracy and reasoning marks, typeset maths and a glossary. Try-it questions sit inside the lessons, so you practise as you read.

### Practise with a Teacher's Eye
- 899 original questions with worked solutions: multiple choice, numeric and written-answer
- Each question is tagged by difficulty and command term, and numeric answers are checked two independent ways in our build process
- Adaptive quizzes choose what you meet next from how you have been answering
- After a quiz, every miss links to the lesson that explains it and to the prerequisite you may need first, with a one-line reason
- Mastery rings for every point show where you are secure and where you are not
- A command-terms check helps you answer exactly what the question asks

### See the Maths Move
22 labs run on your own numbers: graphs and transformations, tangents and optimisation, normal and binomial distributions, regression and hypothesis tests, finance and loans, population models, epidemics, cooling and predator and prey. A scientific calculator pad is always at hand.

### Real-World Builds
Switch from the classical order to the Real-World view and learn by making something: compare loan offers, model an epidemic, plan a delivery route, choose where to put the next clinic, design the cheapest can. Each step teaches the concept just in time, runs a lab with your figures and ends with check questions that update your mastery.

### Exam Practice
12 timed papers and topic checks in the style of Paper 1, Paper 2 and Paper 3, with mark-by-mark reports. An Exploration planner helps you choose an idea, pace the milestones and scan a draft for mathematical vocabulary, in your own words.

### Other Boards
Moving between countries or planning for university? Each topic has a quiet "Other boards" link to equivalent content in GCSE, A Level, other IB maths and AP courses, with honest match levels.

### Built for Comfort
Light, clear design, text size from 50 to 300 percent, layouts for iPhone and iPad, and no account needed. Your progress stays on your device.

### About the Content
Written for the current course, first assessed in 2021, with its final assessment in November 2028. A newer course, first assessed in 2029, is not covered by this version. Your guide and your teacher decide what is examined; this app does not guarantee any grade.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
